title: Gravity draws objects toward the center of a planet
summary: Gravity is the pull by which a planet or another body draws objects toward its center.
body: NASA Space Place defines gravity as the force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center. The same page says that pull keeps the planets in orbit around the Sun. Orbit sizes and escape speed are other cards. This sentence is the definition of the pull toward the center, from the article dated 17 December 2020.

sources.title: What Is Gravity?
sources.author: NASA Space Place
sources.note: NASA Space Place, article last updated 17 December 2020. Paraphrase of the page's own sentence. Public-domain US federal page. Supports the opening definition: a planet draws objects toward its center.
